facts.business: United Spirits Limited manufactures, sells and distributes an outstanding collection of iconic Global and Indian brands, blending global expertise with local innovation to deliver world-class products and experiences to consumers.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis on Additional Inquiry into erstwhile non-executive Chairman and potentially improper transactions, regulatory notices from SEBI, Directorate of Enforcement, AD banks, and rationalisation of overseas subsidiaries subject to regulatory approvals.

key_risks: Foreign currency risk exposure (net exposure of Rs (18) crore as at March 31, 2026)

Litigation with a bank where assets (freehold land Rs 118 crore, buildings Rs 14 crore, leasehold land Rs 4 crore, plant and equipment Rs 0 crore, investments in USL Benefit Trust Rs 120 crore) are pledged as security
Regulatory notices from SEBI, Directorate of Enforcement, Authorised Dealer banks and other agencies post Additional Inquiry
Rationalisation process for divestment/liquidation/merger of certain overseas subsidiaries subject to regulatory approvals
Suits filed for recovery of amounts against relevant parties and individuals identified in Additional Inquiry
facts.related_party_note: Diageo Plc (Ultimate holding company) runs various equity settled share based plans such as Discretionary Incentive Plan (DIP), Performance Share Plan (PSP) etc. for employees of the Company.
